name: openvino
description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
one_liner: A toolkit from Intel that makes AI models run faster and cheaper on everyday computer chips instead of needing expensive specialized hardware.
buyer: A hardware or edge-device company — security cameras, retail kiosks, industrial sensors — that needs to run AI models on-device without cloud costs or GPUs.
business_use_cases: A smart-camera or retail-analytics company runs object detection directly on in-store cameras instead of streaming video to the cloud.
An industrial IoT integrator optimizes defect-detection models to run on ordinary factory-floor PCs.
A consultant specializes in 'shrink your AI model to run on cheap hardware' optimization services for hardware startups.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid model-optimization consulting for companies wanting to deploy AI on edge or CPU hardware instead of expensive GPUs.
Build and sell a pre-optimized model pack tuned for common edge devices in a specific vertical like retail or security.

steal_this: Take a popular open vision model, optimize it with this toolkit for a cheap device like a Raspberry Pi or Intel NUC, and sell the optimized package to the maker/hobbyist audience this weekend.
